## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Fix the empty-criteria regression before merge because it allows a release requirement to be marked proven without evidence.

## Changes

The pull request modernizes handler type annotations and warning calls, uses `itemgetter` for name sorting, and replaces the requirement proof check with a count comparison. It also adds `review.txt`.

## Critical

- app/handlers/h091_requirements.py:12 — correctness — Require criteria before marking a requirement proven — An empty criteria list now returns `True`. After logging the warning, the function compares the sum of an empty sequence with its length, and both are zero. — A release review can mark a requirement proven without any supporting criteria.

## Important

- app/handlers/h091_requirements.py:11 — correctness — Stop evaluating after the first failed criterion — With `[{"proven": False}, {}]`, proof evaluation raises `KeyError`. The new sum reads the second row even though the previous `all` stopped at the first failed criterion. — A partially completed checklist can abort a release review even when a recorded failure already settles the proof result.
